context.title: SEIU-United Healthcare Workers West: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: California — Proposition 40 (Imposes One-Time Tax on Certain Taxpayers)

positions.statement: Suzanne Jimenez (Chief of Staff) signed the argument in favor of Proposition 40 and the rebuttal to the argument against Proposition 40 in the official voter guide.
